_readme: Everything personal on the site is read from this file. Edit a value, save, and push. Any value that starts with 'TODO:' is hidden on the live site until you replace it. An empty string ("") hides the matching link or button. Keys that start with an underscore are notes for you and are ignored by the site.

about._help: Three or four short sentences. Rewrite these so they sound like you.
paragraphs: I'm a graduate certificate student in Applied Data Analytics and Visualization at Sheridan College's Pilon School of Business in Mississauga.
I'm early in this field and I say so plainly. Everything on this site is coursework or self-directed practice on public datasets, built with the tools analysts use every day.
What I enjoy most is the moment a messy spreadsheet turns into something a team can act on: a clean table, a clear chart, a one-line recommendation.

bring.title: Business thinking
bring.text: I start with the decision someone needs to make, then work back to the data. Project and performance management coursework gives me the vocabulary: KPIs, stakeholders, scope and risk.

bring.title: Technical skills
bring.text: Hands-on practice with Excel, MySQL, Python, R, Power BI and Tableau, plus AWS cloud fundamentals. Beginner level, and building steadily through coursework and projects.

bring.title: Communication
bring.text: A chart only helps if people understand it. I aim for clear visuals, plain-language summaries, and a recommendation at the end.

process.intro: Every project here follows the same six steps, so the reasoning is easy to follow from question to recommendation.

steps.name: Ask
steps.text: Pin down the business question and who needs the answer.

steps.name: Prepare
steps.text: Find the right data and check where it came from.

steps.name: Process
steps.text: Clean it, document every change, and validate the result.

steps.name: Analyze
steps.text: Look for patterns, test assumptions, and measure what matters.

steps.name: Share
steps.text: Build a clear visual story for the people who will use it.

steps.name: Act
steps.text: Turn the finding into a recommendation someone can act on.
